scenario_name: Defeating VLAN Hopping and Double Tagging Attacks
base_template: Write a technical security alert (2-3 sentences) explaining how an attacker in the Guest segment (VLAN {{guest_id}}) is attempting to bypass security to reach the Admin segment (VLAN {{admin_id}}) using double-tagging. Mention the switches {{switch_a}} and {{switch_b}}.

guest_name.instruction: A name for the guest VLAN (e.g. Guest, Visitors)

admin_name.instruction: A name for the admin VLAN (e.g. Admin, Management)

guest_id.instruction: Generate a high VLAN ID between 100 and 200 (integer)

admin_id.instruction: Generate a management VLAN ID between 10 and 50 (integer)

expected_solution: Change native VLAN on both trunk ports to an unused VLAN (e.g. 999) and add switchport nonegotiate to disable DTP.
